Data.description: CSV table containing state-level obesity aggregation results. Columns: State (full name), Total_Population (summed county populations), Total_Obese_Population (sum of obese individuals per county), County_Count (number of counties), Avg_Obesity_Pct (mean obesity prevalence). Covers 49 US states + DC, derived from 3,087 counties.
